priorReviews.summary: Independent review of Jin shu 53 (愍懷太子). Year-level Hui-era conversions that stay inside their lunar year are supported: 惠帝即位 AD 290; 元康元年 AD 291; 九年六月 AD 299; 永康元年 months 1/3/6 AD 300; 永甯/永寧元年 AD 301; 太安元年三月 / 太安初 AD 302. The main Western-year defect is 元康九年十二月, whose concordance month begins 8 Jan AD 300 (annals 十二月壬戌), so deposition, trial, 考竟 deaths, and the AD 299 hints built from them are incorrect. Childhood 武帝愛之 and 太子時年五歲 are undated attestations, not unresolved years or a 266–290 Wu-reign window; 23 sui at death must not be inverted into a birth year. Invented 元康中 291–299 intervals, exact AD 290 for undated Guangling/tutor scenes, and filiation-only 291 father claims are unsupported. Later comparisons (宣帝, 楊氏故事, 申生/孝己, 楚建/戾園, 史臣曰) and 太安初 追諡 are reception, not living activity. Princess Changguang’s words are a forgery. Lady of Yicheng’s death and Bin’s birth are attested without years. Competing annal days (六月壬寅 vs 己卯; 五月己巳 vs 四月) are preserved without choosing a winner. Hints must be rebuilt from the surviving personal events.

report.summary: Independent review of Jinshu 53 chronology for Sima Yu and the seventy related figures. Year-level conversions hold: 惠帝即位 is AD 290; 元康元年 is AD 291; Yuankang 9/xii through Yongkang 1 (明年正月, 三月, 四月, 六月) are AD 300 because that twelfth lunar month begins 300-01-08, not the conventional 299 reign-year label; 永寧/永甯元年 is AD 301; 太安元年三月 and 太安初 are AD 302 as the renxu year-label. January 300 has a 0-day Julian/proleptic-Gregorian offset; later 300–302 months differ by one day but not in Western year. Ages 五歲 and 二十三 remain sui without inferred births. Undated childhood, Guangling staff, marriage, and exemplum notices are correctly unmarked by year. Retrospective reception (restoration edict parallels, appraisal comparisons, 追封/追諡) is kept off living hints. Annals give competing days or months—六月壬寅 versus this chapter’s 己卯 for the burial, 五月己巳 versus 己巳 after 四月 for Zang’s heirship, 五月 versus 八月 for Shang’s heirship—but they do not disturb the year-level claims. No omitted birth, death, or age that this chapter actually dates was found, and active hints track supported personal events rather than dynasty-long windows.
